hookups.source: https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/jordan-lake-state-rec-area/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NC&parkId=552903 (site list for the Crosswinds, Parkers Creek and Poplar Point loops, read 2026-10-22: 219 electric sites 'Electric Hookup available: 50 amp' (Crosswinds B and C, Poplar Point C and F), 360 at 30 amp, all with 'Water Hookup') + https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/jordan-lake-state-recreation-area/camping ('134 sites have electric and water hookups' etc.), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Three family campgrounds: Crosswinds 141 sites on the booking site (Area A non-electric, B and C 50-amp electric/water), Parkers Creek 247 (30-amp electric/water and non-electric), Poplar Point 573 (30- and 50-amp electric/water and non-electric). The park page gives 182, 250 and 579. 27 pull-throughs (most at Poplar Point); back-in driveways listed from 23 ft, nearly all 40 ft or more. Vista Point's 50 RV sites are group camping only; New Hope Overlook is walk-in backpack camping.

sites.source: ReserveAmerica site list for the Crosswinds, Parkers Creek and Poplar Point loops (site type, driveway column) + https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/jordan-lake-state-recreation-area/camping ('Crosswinds offers 182 campsites', 'Parkers Creek offers 250 sites', 'Poplar Point offers 579 sites', 'Vista Point offers 50 campsites for group RV camping', 'New Hope Overlook offers 24 campsites ... from 100 yard to a half mile from the parking lot'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Showers, restrooms and a dump station at each of Crosswinds, Parkers Creek and Poplar Point. Parkers Creek Loop 1's toilet-only comfort station is closed until repaired (October 2026 alert).

facilities.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/jordan-lake-state-recreation-area/camping ('Showers, restrooms, trash containers, and a dump station are conveniently located', for each campground) + park page alert ('Parkers Creek Loop 1 comfort station (these are toilets only) closed indefinitely until repairs are made'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Booking page: campsites 'can be made for today and can be made up to 6 Month(s) in advance'. Loops 3 and 4 at Parkers Creek and Loop E at Poplar Point are walk-up only, first come first served. Holiday weekends (Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day) need 2 nights, cut to 1 night when booking within 14 days of arrival.

flags: Entry scope: it is the whole Jordan Lake SRA, which has three family campgrounds (Crosswinds 182 sites, Parkers Creek 250, Poplar Point 579) plus Vista Point (group RV only) and New Hope Overlook (walk-in backpack sites). The pin 35.7326,-79.0172 is at none of them: ~0.3 km from the Visitor Center (park GPS 35.7355,-79.0165), ~1.2 km from Poplar Point Access (35.7289,-79.0044) and ~1.7 km from Crosswinds Campground (35.7420,-79.0021); Parkers Creek (35.7381,-79.0410) is ~2.2 km west across the lake. AWH's note ('Many lakefront campsites') fits any of the three.
